intro.text: The platinum is awarded for holding the other 54 trophies.
There is no multiplayer and no DLC requirement.

steps.text: Play the five chapters in order; the 12 story trophies pop automatically.
Start every side chain when it appears — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal.
Do the one possibly-missable action in Chapter 1: the balcony meditation for #28.
After the credits, work the 100% checklist in Stage 3 — it holds 15 trophies.
Clear the one-offs and riddles in Stage 4; the platinum pops with the last trophy.
All 55 are offline, with no difficulty setting — one playthrough is enough.
Keep cheats off — they disable trophies AND saving (61 cheats, none work before the credits anyway).

tips.text: If it has not popped, filter the tracker to Unearned and clear the shortest stage first.

intro.text: The first main mission of Chapter 1.
It pops automatically when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1 from the start — the mission is the story's opening.
Finish 'Gone Fishing' — no optional objective is needed for the trophy.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 — the roadmap's save plan is the only protection against the one possibly-missable trophy.

intro.text: Pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'.

steps.text: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission in order.
Start Chapter 2 and complete its first mission, 'What's in the Bag?'.
The trophy pops then — Chapter 1 is complete.
Keep a manual save at the end of Chapter 1 as well — 10 chapter-boundary saves cover the whole story.

intro.text: Pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.

steps.text: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission, including 'Breakfast Run' (#8).
Start Chapter 3 and complete 'Welcome to Vice City'.
The trophy pops then — Chapter 2 is complete.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 2 — the save plan uses 10 of the 15 slots.

intro.text: Pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.

steps.text: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission, including 'The Cartel Heist' (#9).
Start Chapter 4 and complete 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
The trophy pops then — Chapter 3 is complete.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 3.

intro.text: Pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'.

steps.text: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, including 'Child's Play', 'Headliners' and 'VCIA Takedown'.
Complete the final Chapter 4 mission, 'Starting From Zero'.
The trophy pops then — Chapter 4 is complete.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 4.

intro.text: The story's final mission.
It pops automatically — no chapter number is asserted for it, because the guides disagree on the wording (see dispute d09).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish Chapters 1–4 and reach the final mission.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing after this point is missable.
Keep a manual save before the final mission — save 10 of the planner.

intro.text: A Chapter 2 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 and play 'Breakfast Run'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
After this mission, free-roam together unlocks, which the partner feats (#33, #34) need.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.

intro.text: A Chapter 3 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 and play 'The Cartel Heist'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.

intro.text: A Chapter 4 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play 'Child's Play'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.

intro.text: A Chapter 4 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play 'Headliners'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.

intro.text: A Chapter 4 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play 'VCIA Takedown'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.

intro.text: A Chapter 5 mission trophy.
Automatic.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 5 and play 'Operation Savage Glory'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at its end.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 5.

intro.text: The hardest trophy.
The checklist opens after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion); progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable.

steps.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits and read the checklist.
Clear the partial lines first: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations.
Clear the full lines: robberies, underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting golds, all 14 drone locations, all 15 Target Decks, all 8 bank jobs, all 39 gang operations.
Study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars — every dog and cat breed counts separately, and no hunting or skinning is needed.
Optional missions: 100 needed of 200–300+; purple icons and black icons with pink letters are optional, main missions are pink icons with black letters.
Each Moses or Randy vehicle delivery counts toward the 100 optional missions, and each meditation spot counts +2 if done with both characters.
The checklist is closer to 60% true completion — most lines ask for only part of a set.
Expect about 100 hours for this stage, after 60–80 hours of story.
A few magazine collectibles in story buildings are permanently inaccessible, but they also spawn elsewhere and are not needed for trophies.

tips.text: Track every line live in the 100% Ledger tab of this guide.

intro.text: Any 250 of 397 stunts count.
Four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps (ramps), 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights (between buildings), 25 Base Jumps (parachute).

steps.text: Track stunts by region (Progress > Activities > Stunts) and by name on the map (Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Stunt Jumps use ramps; Knife Flights thread between buildings; Base Jumps need a parachute.
Mix the four kinds freely — Under the Bridges are the quickest.
The trophy pops at 250; the 100% checklist needs 300 (see dispute d13).

trophies.description: Try each of the 9 activity types.

intro.text: Nine activity types, each tried once.
View them at Touchpad > Progress > Activities.

trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Try Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops) and Playing a Video Game.
Win a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun Drone Race.
Perform a stunt — any stunt counts toward the ninth type.
Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types are still untried.
Most types come automatically from the story and map unfogging.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

intro.text: 12 Shooting Range locations, 42 gold medals in total.
All 42 are needed — and all 42 are needed for 100% too.

trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Find the 12 Shooting Range locations across Leonida.
Earn gold in every challenge at each range — 42 golds in total.
Gold also raises Combat Focus, which the Gunslinger trophy (#36) needs.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

intro.text: 14 locations, 42 drone races in total.
Every location is needed.

trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations.
Win at least one race at each location — 42 races exist in total.
You need a win at each location, not all 42 race wins.
All 14 locations are also a full line on the 100% checklist.

intro.text: 40 unique race locations exist; any 20 wins count.

steps.text: Find race locations on the map — 40 in total.
Win 20 different races; repeats at the same location do not add new wins.
Races also feed the Master of None activity types (#16).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

intro.text: Cal's fishing questline.
After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', Cal texts a fishing location (purple map icon).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Finish 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)' in Chapter 1.
Follow Cal's texts to the fishing spot (purple map icon).
Follow the questline and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

intro.text: Four in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
'Complete' means finishing all levels once — no need to beat every challenge.

steps.text: Play the first three at the TV at home (from Chapter 1; temporarily unavailable in some story sections, still doable after the story).
Play the fourth at arcade machines in the world.
Finish all levels of any one game once.

intro.text: Andy's questline, Lucia only.
Marked automatically in Chapter 3; Andy calls, then texts her home address (Belville).

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 as Lucia and wait for Andy's call, then his text.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3) and Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Complete Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
Still available after the story — the window is only about starting it when it appears.

tips.text: Lucia-only: Jason cannot start this chain.

intro.text: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1.
After 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' he calls; a green 'KR' icon appears in Key Lento.

steps.text: Finish 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' in Chapter 1.
Follow Kenton's purple chest icons and find underwater treasures with the metal detector; bring them back.
7 shipwrecks in total. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 — call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up. Not missable.

intro.text: Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'.
Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County.

steps.text: Finish 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2.
Complete Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club) and Twist Wrist Smash Grab.
Complete Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes.
Still available after the story.

intro.text: Eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as 'strangers'.

steps.text: Start every stranger chain when it appears — the full list of eight is not settled (see dispute d03).
Confirmed counting strands (PowerPyx): Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm quests), Yago (street-race quests), Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests).
Track progress via the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
All strands are findable after the story in free roam.

tips.text: TechWiser warns stranger chains behind hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress — start them early.

intro.text: Randy's questline ('Randy's Wish List'), marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)'.
That mission unlocks the Key Cloner (break into high-end sports cars).

steps.text: Finish 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' in Chapter 3.
Deliver 16 sports cars Randy wants; track under Map > Robberies (money-bag icon) > Randy's Wish List.
Cars are often parked or driving in east Vice City (Vice Beach / Ocean Beach); a green 'RK' icon marks Randy in west Vice City.
Scan cars with WAiNK to check if one is on the list; deliver in good condition for more pay.
Still doable after the story.

intro.text: Tyrone's questline, Jason only.
Marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'.

steps.text: Finish 'Here, Kitty Kitty' in Chapter 3.
Follow the purple markers for Synthetic Labs in Vice City and destroy the labs (quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter').
Tyrone then gives 'Spin On This' (Shut Down the Labs) — complete it.
Still available after the story.

tips.text: Jason-only: Lucia cannot start this chain.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

intro.text: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations.
Meditate with BOTH Jason and Lucia at each spot — each spot then counts twice.
Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The last spot needs both leads playable (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break').
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she will meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and accept the optional prompt.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this trophy pops — this is the game's only possibly-missable action.
Meditate at each of the 18 spots with both Jason and Lucia.
The last spot needs both leads playable — after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'.
The counter in this guide counts to 18; the 100% list stops at 15 (see dispute d01).
PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing the balcony meditation; whether that one is required is unconfirmed (see dispute d02).

tips.text: The balcony meditation raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.

intro.text: Bret Vogel's questline, Jason only.
Marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'; while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' in Lummox County (Lucia can't receive it).

steps.text: Finish 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2, then play as Jason and wait for Bret's text.
Meet Bret in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to Bret as Jason.
The first quest gives the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation).
One clean shot leaves animals pristine and pays more — not mandatory.
Track under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck. 15 Target Decks in total; all 15 are needed for 100%.
Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still unconfirmed (see dispute d08).

intro.text: 18 card-set locations exist in total (PowerPyx guide).
Any 3 complete sets pop the trophy.

steps.text: Find card-set locations across Leonida — 18 in total.
Complete any 3 sets.
The other 15 locations are for collectors only (see dispute d24).

intro.text: WAiNK scans are objects you scan (hold Up + R1).
More than 100 exist; any 100 count.
Breakdown: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan objects with R1.
More than 100 scannable objects exist — any 100 count.
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — 89 named categories in total.
Top up the last scans with No Flusher Tags (see dispute d16).

intro.text: 80 challenges exist; only 50 are needed for the trophy, 70 of 80 for 100%.
Track under Progress > Challenges (checkmark bottom-right when scrolling over a challenge).

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest unfinished ones.
A checkmark at the bottom-right marks a completed challenge when you scroll over it.
Most complete naturally while working on other trophies — save this for late.
The trophy pops at 50; the 100% line needs 70 (see dispute d14).

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner.

intro.text: Earliest after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (free-roam together; call your partner with hold Right + Triangle).

trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Finish 'Coffee Break', then call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Get 4 stars (cause carnage), then escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; shoot a chasing helicopter down if needed.
Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — cops struggle on train tracks, the helicopter can't see you.
The trophy pops after leaving the red 'heat' wanted zone (not the blue/red flashing search area).
It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' / large bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars (see dispute d20).

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

intro.text: Only after 'Coffee Break'.
Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while chased the whole time; maintain the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Finish 'Coffee Break', then call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Gear up: armored vest + sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation), Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
Good spot: the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'); rob a couple of items in each, go to the back room, break the safe with sticky bombs.
If it doesn't pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th — the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop (see dispute d22).

intro.text: 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Scanning is enough — no need to drive them.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up to open instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic.
Also scan boats and aircraft — they count toward the 200 for 100%.
Track under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The trophy pops at 100; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles (see dispute d15).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

intro.text: Combat Focus: L3+R3 while aiming a firearm; slows time, highlights vulnerable spots, drains the purple focus bar.
Does NOT work on soldiers, police, or civilians.

trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Buff focus first (food/drinks, wash face/shower at home, Adrenaline to extend).
Raise Focus to a higher level first — 4 levels exist (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye icon); raise it via Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, fishing, headshots.
Line up 5 enemies (best at Gang Operations), defeat them quickly without missing; an assault rifle (Duke 556) is more accurate than pistols/SMGs; wear body armor (Ammu-Nation).
Soldiers, police and civilians do not count — pick gang enemies.
Easier late; it may pop naturally.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

intro.text: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal (connected to a passenger boarding bridge — NOT the planes on the airfield).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Easiest: the plane at departure terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence around the airfield — stairs by the boarding bridge lead straight into the plane (or enter on foot through the terminal).
Do not take the planes sitting on the airfield — only a terminal-docked plane counts.
Inside: go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off.
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy pops then.

intro.text: Tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map (Mariana County), in the south of the air base.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south-west edge of the map.
Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

intro.text: First finish Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silently lockpick alarmed doors) and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons in unfogged map areas).

trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Finish 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' in Chapter 3.
Break in through the backdoor with the Snap Gun (don't kick the door — that triggers the alarm).
In the backroom: find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage, disable the alarm.
Pops shortly after leaving the store. Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City.

intro.text: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' (marked automatically from story progress) — it introduces bank vault robberies; the first one is done in the mission.

steps.text: Finish 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the first vault robbery is done in the mission.
After that: tail a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and the vault opens; go in while it is open and rob it.
Bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag — you can't carry all the cash alone).
After the quest, pay Yasmani (fence, unlocked Chapter 3) for security-van tips — $10,000 each, after doing his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans) — vans get a purple map icon.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
8 Large Bank Jobs exist in total; 5 needed for the trophy, all 8 for 100% (see dispute d18). Up to $205,000 per bank — the best endgame money.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

intro.text: Unlocked automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck (you tail the truck to the bank).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Finish 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the vault robbery in it counts as the truck robbery.
Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up; pops only after escaping the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (see dispute d21).
All 8 Large Bank Jobs are needed for 100%, so this pops automatically while clearing them.

intro.text: Fully unfog the whole map — best done by plane, flying over every black-fog area until the map is visible.
The kit list says 'all 52 areas of Leonida'; PowerPyx says unfog the whole map — both versions are shown in dispute d10.

steps.text: Take a plane and fly over every black-fog area until the map is visible.
Fly low over black-fog areas until they turn visible on the map.
The trophy pops when the whole map is unfogged.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

intro.text: 9 gangs, 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total.
1 per gang for the trophy; all 39 for 100%.

trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when nearby; many are marked automatically from story progress.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track under Progress > Gangs (scroll over a gang — bottom-right shows how many of its operations you robbed).
All 39 are needed for 100% (see dispute d17).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

intro.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

intro.text: Steal the specific blue 'Banshee' from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom's window.
Requires the Key Cloner (Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)').
Only this blue Banshee works — an easter egg referencing the Banshee from GTA III.
The pop is slightly delayed (after driving further away).

trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: Finish 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and take the specific blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom's window, then keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed.
Other lists mark this trophy unconfirmed; PowerPyx gives the full method (see dispute d07).

trophies.description: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling.

intro.text: Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn), one of the Gang Operations.
Buy sticky bombs first (Ammu-Nation — needed to blow the safe). The alley is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

steps.text: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first.
Inside, take the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon).
Take the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the north-east table (golden icon), then blow the safe in the north-east hallway office with sticky bombs.
Pops after escaping the police, not on picking up the third item. Killing enemies is not necessary.
NOT missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the rest.

trophies.description: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

intro.text: Only after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching).
Check strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character > Strength (heart icon).

trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Finish 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2 to unlock character switching.

Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership; always go together with both characters (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other completes training automatically (double progress).
Check strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character > Strength (heart icon).
Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); many across Vice City; also work out at home after the story.

trophies.description: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

intro.text: View the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen when an action counts.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first, so you can see actions counting.
View the running count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

Profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives/robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing — shooting limbs), Violent (killing enemies/civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops/civilians, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence — avoid it; cops shoot on sight more).
Mostly pops passively while doing other trophies and 100%; if not, farm by running over civilians/cops with a car.

tips.text: Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

intro.text: Trigger currently unknown.
PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — a belief, not a confirmed fact.

steps.text: No confirmed method exists — do not grind for it.
The belief: something to do with the Payday Loans store from the Prologue (see dispute d05).
It may pop on its own while doing robberies for 100%.

intro.text: UFO Easter Egg.
Road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, come solo. Slightly random, not a guaranteed spawn.

steps.text: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone.
At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and come back (see dispute d23).
Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods — you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky).
Approach it; the UFO drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and it pops.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

intro.text: Trigger currently unknown.
PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a belief, not a confirmed fact.

trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: No confirmed method exists — do not grind for it.
The belief: kick enemies while driving a motorcycle (see dispute d06).
Try kicks from a bike in free roam while doing other trophies.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

intro.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills.
Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Finish 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' in Chapter 3.
Rob Banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Bring them to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. $250,000 total, cumulative — no need to bring it all at once.
Comes naturally while doing all robberies for 100%. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4 'That's Where The Money Is…').

intro.text: Cumulative.

Fastest: guns, car mods, tattoos (the most expensive). Shop counts: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair & Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics Stores.

steps.text: Spend across any shops — the total is cumulative.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos.
It comes naturally while gearing up for the other trophies.

intro.text: 8 purchasable garages + 4 story-related garages; only the 8 purchasable are needed.
Total cost $160,000.

Available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' — a notification says a new phone app was installed ('Vice City Real Estate'); buy the garages through the phone app.

steps.text: Finish 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' in Chapter 2.
Open the 'Vice City Real Estate' phone app and buy the 8 garages ($160,000 total).
Fast money: robberies, especially Chapters 3–4 higher-value ones.
Story garages do not count (see dispute d19).
Each garage adds parking spots — you need them for #55 On the Spot.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

intro.text: The app is installed on the phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'.
It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location.
You need enough garages first (see #54) — each garage adds 1+ parking spots.

trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: Finish 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)' in Chapter 2.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click 'Respray' and 'Register'.
Moses is unlocked by the same mission. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses low.
